{{Quote|He says he was headed up here from the droid access tunnel. He was still fifty or sixty meters downslope when he experienced an emergency shutdown. He woke up under the tree.|Female Quarren Pop-Dog to her partner|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served in the [[Pop-Dogs]], an elite unit of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]].<ref name="MK" />

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> she and her [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified female Human Pop-Dog (Kuratooine)|partner]] were assigned to guard an abandoned mine at the western edge of where [[Chakham Army Base]] was located on the  [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. On one of their patrols, they saw a [[Unidentified maintenance droid (Kuratooine)|maintenance droid]] trapped underneath a fallen tree. Her partner partially lifted the tree, allowing the droid to scramble free. When questioned by the Quarren about how he had become trapped, the maintenance droid answered that he did not know. The Human Pop-Dog then surmised that the tree had fallen on him, causing the droid to reinitialize and potentially cross-link or corrupt his memories. The Pop-Dogs then dragged the tree completely clear, after which the maintenance droid followed them as they departed.<ref name="MK" />
